name: promptcut
description: Turn a prompt into a finished video: storyboard, TTS voiceover, generated or stock images, Ken Burns motion, ducked music, subtitles, ffmpeg render. Plus ~30 granular editing commands, full CapCut draft export and editable project export for Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and VEGAS Pro.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key from openrouter.ai/keys, used for image generation and TTS. The OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable works instead.

capcut_drafts_dir.title: CapCut drafts folder
capcut_drafts_dir.description: Copy it from CapCut > Settings > Draft location. Only needed for CapCut export.
